messages:
Sasha: quick sketch — thinking about a 'mini metrics' row beneath the p95 heatmap: small p50/p95/p99 chips + tiny sparkline, compact by default, expand on hover or keyboard focus. keeps main chart clean but surfaces common SLIs.

Priya: curious — does this duplicate the latency card? want to avoid >2 ways to see p95. what's the primary goal: faster actability or denser info?

Sasha: primary = faster actability. product teams keep asking for a compact way to compare model routes at a glance without opening the full panel. not a replacement for the big card, just a quick scannable row.

Carlos: love the idea. a couple engineering notes: 1) continuous sparklines need aggregation at the same resolution as the main chart to avoid confusion, 2) keep sequence alignment with the main timepicker so scrubbing matches.

Mei: accessibility nits: if the mini row is focusable, we need clear keyboard affordance and an ARIA label per metric, e.g. aria-label="p95 latency for route X, last 15 minutes" and aria-live for updates. Also colorblind palette (Okabe-Ito) for the sparkline bars would help.

Priya: UX question — how to handle sampling? We already sample heatmap traces heavily during high QPS. If the mini row is supposed to be representative, sampling distortions may be worse. Suggest we add a tiny sampling indicator + option: "sampling: auto / exact (costly) / representative"

Sasha: agreed. mockup idea: an overflow kebab on the mini row with "Sampling: Auto" pill. Hover reveals quick explainer: "Auto picks representative traces to preserve trend while limiting cost. Switch to Exact to compute full percentiles (incurs compute cost)."

Carlos: implementation sketch for sampling config (pseudo):
```
{
  mode: 'auto' | 'exact' | 'representative',
  window: '5m' | '15m' | '1h',
  sketch_seed: 42 // for deterministic sampling in UI
}
```
If we expose this, add an obvious warning about potential cost bump when Exact is chosen.

Mei: keyboard flow: Tab should land on each metric chip, Enter expands the mini card (focus moves into expanded panel), Escape collapses back. For screen readers, announce expansion state: "Expanded: p95 mini card for route X". Also contrast check: chips must meet 4.5:1 for small text.

Priya: copy tweak for the sampling tooltip: current "representative" is ambiguous. Proposal: "Representative — uses stratified sampling to keep trends stable". Short and actionable.

Sasha: new visual note — when the mini sparkline is collapsed, show small delta badges (▲/▼) with hover to reveal exact numbers. That keeps density without reading full chart.

Carlos: backend constraint: delta badges must be computable from the same aggregation window as the main chart to avoid mismatch. We'll add a shared aggregation layer call. Also we can cache the per-route mini-row snapshot for 30s to reduce load.

Mei: a11y keyboard microcopy: add a sr-only hint: "Press Enter to expand metrics row and view full chart". Also ensure focus style is visible even on dense dark themes.

Priya: ok let's capture action items: Sasha to update mockups with keyboard states + collapsed/expanded states; Carlos to prototype lightweight API that returns mini-row payload with sampling metadata; Mei to run contrast + screen reader checks on the mock; I'll write concise tooltip copy variants and send one-liners for the kebab menu.

Sasha: got it — I'll upload updated frames by EOD tomorrow. tagging dev-bot to create a follow-up issue. :rocket:

dev-bot: Created issue #4127: "mini metrics row for latency dashboard — mock + sampling API" and assigned to Sasha, Carlos, Mei, Priya. Due: 2026-03-26.

Carlos: quick question — do we want the mini row to be per-model-route only, or permit cross-model comparisons? Cross-model introduces naming/legend complexity. My vote: start per-route, then iterate.

Priya: per-route first, cross-model in a later iteration. we can add a filter in 2.0.

Sasha: agreed. I'll reflect that in mock copy: "Showing p95 for route: /generate (click to compare models)" (click to compare is disabled in v1).

Mei: final note — check voiceover announcement volume for rapid updates; if the mini row updates every few seconds we should debounce SR announcements to avoid spamming.

Sasha: great catch. will add a 10s debounce for aria-live updates. thanks all! :raised_hands:
